purpose: Committed startCoachSession reads: what the coach was handed, and every provider request it cost, for one fixed instant per scenario

scenarios.01_revisit_today__no_reconcile: Today's session on a day with a client recovery upload and stated available days, with no provider activity to match
scenarios.01_revisit_today__reconcile: The same read where Monday's easy run pairs with its delivered event, so the plan moves and the context is rebuilt against it
scenarios.02_review_week__no_reconcile: The Monday after the plan's stored week, with a full wellness feed, a stated habit, a reported lift and a session no device recorded
scenarios.02_review_week__reconcile: The same week review where Sunday's long run pairs and the plan moves
scenarios.03_review_cycle__no_reconcile: Day 26 of the 28-day cycle, reading the whole cycle back with one unmatched provider activity in it
scenarios.03_review_cycle__reconcile: The same cycle review where a session inside the cycle pairs and the plan moves
scenarios.04_structured_run__no_reconcile: Today's session is the one the plan prescribes more than one step for, with an activity on the day that is not paired to it
scenarios.04_structured_run__reconcile: The multi-step session pairs with its own activity, and the per-segment read comes back with three of the five prescribed repetitions run and the session ended early
scenarios.05_sparse_recovery__values_mostly_absent: Wellness rows the provider answered for but filled in almost nothing on -- a read with no reading, which is not a bad reading
scenarios.06_recovery_read_fails: The wellness endpoint answers 500 on an account that has a plan: the turn still answers, with recovery unread rather than measured
scenarios.07_red_flag__no_reconcile: Today's read with a symptom reported true, and nothing to reconcile
scenarios.07_red_flag__reconcile: The same symptom read where a session also pairs -- a reported symptom must not change what the read is allowed to reconcile
scenarios.08_strength_alias__no_reconcile: One lift under the plan's key and the athlete's own word reads back as one movement; a word no baseline names stays separate and is said
scenarios.08_strength_alias__reconcile: The same aliases, on a read that also reconciles and rebuilds
scenarios.09_no_plan__provider_healthy: An account with no PlanState and a working provider: the first conversation reads the training already on record instead of asking for it
scenarios.10_no_plan__recovery_read_fails: The same empty account with the wellness endpoint down -- the history the first conversation exists to avoid re-asking must survive it
scenarios.11_unresolved_delivery__reconciliation_d: An interrupted delivery's reservation fences the store, so a read that had a session to reconcile defers instead of writing
scenarios.12_plan_authoring__stated_evidence: Near the cycle boundary, with everything the athlete has stated on record: a lost week, an aim past this cycle, a habit, a weight, a lift
scenarios.13_review_cycle__measurement_reference_i: Day 26 of a plan reviewed weekly, whose measurement reference is week one's quality run and whose repeat is this week -- both readings in
scenarios.14_review_cycle__two_sessions_one_day: The same day-26 read of a week-one double day, where one of the two running sessions took the activity and the other is left with no reading
scenarios.15_review_cycle__strength_reported_and_n: The same day-26 read where week one's lower-body day was reported set by set and its upper-body day was not, so one lift has a second record and one has none
scenarios.16_plan_week__quality_series_concedes_on: Day 26 of a plan reviewed weekly, whose threshold anchor built a three-week rising pattern and then, on its fourth exposure, came back at barely half the prescribed time -- issue #255's question of whether a coach reads the family or only the last exposure
scenarios.17_plan_week__strength_pair_same_label: The Monday after a third week whose two strength days -- a heavy lower-body session and an easy upper-body one -- arrive with no body_stress and no cost, carrying only their duration, heart rate, stated feel and the athlete's own name for each: issue #256's question of whether a plan_week turn can tell them apart when it decides what comes next
scenarios.18_structured_run__indoor_reps_complete: The same multi-step session, run indoors: every prescribed repetition was completed and every recorded pace is a fifth slow, because a treadmill's distance is the machine's reading -- issue #252's question of whether the coach can tell a missed target from an uncomparable measurement
scenarios.19_review_cycle__week_one_quality_segmen: The same day-26 read where both ends of the cycle's measurement came back with the provider's per-segment breakdown -- week one's quality run stopped after three of five repetitions, this week's repeat ran all five -- so the older session's repetitions are stated in the read or nowhere
scenarios.20_revisit_today__one_statement: Today's session where the athlete has said one thing about how today feels, with the recovery trends reading within baseline around it
scenarios.21_review_week__statements_across_the_fo: The same Monday week review, where the athlete has said the same thing on five days across both calendar weeks and every wellness trend still reads within baseline
scenarios.22_plan_cycle__the_cycle_was_executed: Day 26 of a plan reviewed weekly whose sessions were actually trained: every prescribed run and lift back with an activity, the threshold series holding its pace across three weeks, and both ends of the cycle's own measurement in with the repeat faster at a lower heart rate
scenarios.23_review_week__same_rollup_opposite_ord: Two sessions of one lift whose per-load arithmetic is identical and whose set order is opposite -- the direction lives only in the session record's ordered sets
scenarios.24_revisit_today__recovery_declining: The evening before the week's threshold anchor, where readiness, HRV, sleep and resting heart rate have all read worse on each of the last three days and nothing names a cause
scenarios.25_plan_cycle__a_peak_and_a_break_in_the: The Monday the next cycle is authored from, for an athlete whose uploaded ten months hold their highest month, their longest single run, and a seven-week stop that no calendar month is empty for
scenarios.26_no_plan__empty_account: A connected account with nothing in it: Intervals answered, the window is empty, and the athlete has stated nothing either

scope: Anonymous and synthetic; built only from examples/garmin-coach-loop-28-day and the fixtures in tests/coach_session_scenarios.py
